plans.starter: Starter · £99 + £25/mo. Your colours, type and logo on this design: your whole menu by treatment, by concern and by time, with minutes and prices; your first-visit notes and patch-test rule, with the day to come in worked out; and a Plan your visit page with every question.
plans.plus: Plus · £199 + £30/mo. Home and four more pages (each part of your menu with its own page counts as one): "How does your skin feel today?", answered by a printed card in your own words; a page for each part of your menu; courses and memberships; your rooms; and your first visit in full.
plans.signature: Signature · £349 + £35/mo. Up to 20 pages, plus the showpieces: the ritual builder that adds up a facial and its extras; a spa day sold as a gift, the card drawn as they type and paid through your own Stripe link; treatment rhythm reminders in their calendar from your own advice; the bridal timeline; your journal; and something made just for your clinic.

gate.plus: Starter is a full home page plus Plan your visit. Plus adds up to four more pages, like this one: treatments by concern, a page for each part of the menu, courses, the rooms and your first visit.
gate.signature: Signature adds the showpieces: the ritual builder, a spa day as a gift, treatment rhythm reminders, the bridal timeline and the journal.
